    IDisplay
    To be implemented by display elements, i.e.
    IDisposalProcessor
    A configured DisposalProcessor's consume method is invoked whenever the Node tree is reorganised, or AppService.close() is called, and a series of Nodes and Injectables that are no longer active is generated.
    ImplementationException
    An ImplementationException provides an idiomatic exception for use by user-implemented constructors and methods that are invoked by the service: i.e.
    ImplementerException
    An ImplementerException wraps any checked or unchecked exception when a user-implemented constructor or method is called into, including AutoCloseable.close() on implementing Nodes and Injectables.
    Injectable
    An Injectable is an object that is hosted by a Node; its lifetime is scoped to the Node it is hosted by.
    InjectableBag
    An InjectableBag stores a series of pre-constructed Injectables.

    OperationException
    An OperationException is thrown from invalid post-configuration calls: when an invalid constant is provided, an invalid argument, or a start method is called on AppService without the necessary configurations.

    Helps with tasks related to locating classes.
    Relationship
    Defines the relationship that the Rule validates.
    Request
    A Request traverses the tree from the originating node to leaf, or from the root to the leaf if passed to the AppService via AppService.request(Request).
    ResolutionFailure
    A ResolutionFailure is thrown when setState, inject, etc.
    ResolutionTermination
    A ResolutionTermination is thrown at the point where a setState, inject, etc.
    Rule<T>
    A validation rule that compares a discovered set of classes against a provided one.
    RuleAny<T>
    A rule which validates successfully if any sub-rule validates.
    ServiceNotConfiguredException
    Thrown if a method on AppService is called that requires it to have been configured.
    ServiceNotRunningException
    Thrown if a method on AppService is called that requires it to have active Nodes.
